facts.fact: 神庙受惊后，Gabriel 仍强迫 Rory 和 Cora 出席王室晚宴，称缺席会显得她们无法融入 seraph 文化、会被国王认为不信 Themis 的神谕；母女俩面对炖肉热面包几乎吃不下。
facts.anchor: Gabriel insisted we take dinner with the royals and some of the nobles in the dining hall. He claimed not showing up would make us look like we couldn’t assimilate to seraph culture and that the king might think that we didn’t believe in the divine absolute of Themis’ word.

facts.fact: 贵族 Voralia 连番追问「人类是不是拜假神」，Rory 险些露馅；Anya 抛出 Henrick 偷偷追求 Isla、怕被 Isla 父亲发现、却被 Nysin 撞见两人在玫瑰园过分亲昵的八卦，全桌贵族立刻被丑闻吸走，Rory 得以脱身。
facts.anchor: Anya chimed in, “Voralia, did you hear the latest gossip about Henrick being seen courting Isla. Apparently, they are trying to hide it so that Isla’s father doesn’t find out, but Nysin saw them in the rose gardens getting a little too cozy.”

facts.fact: 国王 Torrish 喝完第四杯麦酒后摇摇晃晃起身、口齿不清地宣布散席，要与议事会密谈 Edenalee；Gabriel 急忙陪同前往，连自己的剑都忘了带走。
facts.anchor: King Torrish stood after his fourth tankard of ale. The permanent scowl on his face was only eclipsed by the swaying of his body. “Dinner is over. I have a meeting with my council to discuss Edenalee,” he grumbled, his speech slurred.

facts.fact: 国王与 Gabriel 离席后，Mollah 王后支开众人（Anya 带 Cora 先出餐厅）坐到 Rory 身边套话，自称有一项永葆年轻美貌的 glamour enchant、连素颜都不记得了，并说这不是她封后的原因——她和任何 angheal 贵族一样靠攀爬社会阶梯，且比所有人都擅长利用好与坏的秘密把王冠戴到头上。
facts.anchor: I became queen how any angheal noble would: By climbing the social ladder. Though I was much better at it than everyone else, using secrets, good and bad, to get the crown on my head.

facts.fact: Mollah 亮出第二项被动 enchant：她是 audioperceptive，听觉超常、能隔着人群听耳语、能察觉有人偷偷接近；她随即压低声音点破——Rory 在舞会上撞见了她与 Devoruh 私会，令 Rory 心惊是否会被灭口。
facts.anchor: I am audioperceptive. I can hear exceptionally well and at a further distance than most. Whispered conversations across crowded rooms, for instance. I can even tell when people, say, sneak up on me in compromising situations.”

facts.fact: Mollah 点破 Rory 对卫队长 Darragh——她口中的「我亲爱的侄子」——有复杂感情、昨夜被他伤了心、今天又见识了他吓坏所有 seraph 的一面；她暗示若让「军队统帅」知道苦恋的 Rory 心属他此生最恨的男人（Darragh），会给两人招来极大危险，还提到 Gabriel 已把练武室发怒之事告诉了国王和她。
facts.anchor: Now, now, Aurora, you have some complicated feelings for our Captain of the Guard, my dear nephew, don’t you? A tragic outcome of why we don’t cross angheals with other seraphs.

facts.fact: Mollah 以送 atoner 相威胁（若不从还会牵连帮 Rory 欺骗 Gabriel 的 Anya——Anya 正是因拒绝她安排的贵族婚配才被派来当侍女），逼 Rory 缔结不可违背的 covenant binding：她抽出镶月晶与蓝宝石的金匕割开 Rory 手掌立血誓——若泄露她与 Devoruh 在舞会之事，Rory 将承受持续三天、不为人见的剧痛之死，灵魂下冥界、抛下女儿 Cora。
facts.anchor: If you tell anyone about what you saw between Devoruh and me during the ball, then the binding is broken, and you will suffer a painful, unseen death that lasts for three days’ time, until your soul is finally sent to the underworld, leaving behind your daughter.

facts.fact: 誓词说到一半餐厅门开、Gabriel 回来取忘掉的剑；Mollah 迅速把匕首藏回身后，塞给 Rory 一块蓝色亚麻餐巾，谎称她是被碎玻璃割伤手掌；Gabriel 用白色光芒治愈她的手掌并亲吻其手，Mollah 借机与 Rory 约定明日在她房中喝茶「续谈女人间的话题」。
facts.anchor: The doors to the dining hall opened to a pair of lapis blue eyes. Mollah quickly pulled the dagger back to her chest, out of Gabriel’s line of sight.

facts.fact: 回房路上 Rory 权衡后认定 Gabriel 办公室那本书就是穿越屏障、回 Edenalee 的关键；她意识到若拖到明天就要被迫与 seraph 女王缔结血盟，决定今夜就潜入办公室取书。
facts.anchor: I had to go tonight, or tomorrow, I faced having to bind myself to the Queen of Seraphs.
